test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

Logic:- 

 
• Difference between the first and second letter position value according to English alphabetic series is (2).
 
• Difference between the second and third letter position value according to English alphabetic series is (4).

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : TVZ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31dccc8fa313fb6a29dbf6f95fcac47801a3f1f27fb2162737c583c8b6bcef9f.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : KMQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fa26956d212a773f6d63bd593ad5e59ba3f10409dfc08b641bb364521bc69ed.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : EGJ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc51772a95832a2fdbd5896a263e1fd89302505f00702e336790cc82f35273cb.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : BDH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb30b68b3c45ba0ec584e036440d042226026b4dc0773685cfda7b23ccae9a28.png] 

Thus, out of all options only '**EGJ**' doesn't follows the same logic as others.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".

7d:Te4
